narrative.details:
I wish it was that easy to help, champion. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
narrative.objectives: Bring Alexston's Reply to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.
narrative.offerRewardText: Sad news indeed. Still, I thank you for making the journey.With neither Stormwind nor Darnassus coming to aid us, it seems that Auberdine's fate is our own to decide.
narrative.requestItemsText: You have returned. What news comes from Stormwind?
